## Introduction

Your content here. The document opens in dark mode if your OS is set to dark mode,
and the toggle button in the header lets users switch manually.

## A plot

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  labs(x = "Weight", y = "MPG", colour = "Cylinders") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

The plot background is transparent — the One Dark page background shows through.
In light mode, the standard Cosmo theme is used.
